correctness.rationale: The complete claim is a finite exact census over F2, not a statement over arbitrary fields. Reconstructed twelve-bit coefficient masks F=A(Y)X0^2+B(Y)X0X1+C(Y)X1^2; geometric smoothness follows from B nonzero and both-chart F2[t] gcd(B,(A'C+AC')^2+(B')^2AC)=1. An independent polynomial-arithmetic enumerator (not the repository program) found 1116 smooth among 4095 nonzero masks, 39 actual PGL2(F2)^2 orbits (25 of size 36, 11 of size 18, 3 of size 6; Burnside count 39). Independent P1(F4)^2 point enumeration produced all eighteen exact N1/N2/branch-count strata and N1 distribution 0:6,1:36,2:108,3:168,4:396,5:324,6:78. Three six-point orbit representatives are masks 438, 691, 1718 with sizes 36,36,6, N2=6, common Weil numerator 1+3T+5T²+6T³+4T⁴; rational totally-ramified degree-three fibres were independently tested as cubes and found 1,0,0. These exhaust finite objects by full twelve-bit enumeration, not merely a sample; classification is for embedded curves modulo ambient ruling-preserving automorphism, not abstract isomorphism.
